about: Soba Guard iterate script. Use with ?skip=1&wave=10&coins=300. Enter is a no-op in battle (it retries from the Results screen), then: 2 = steamer card, cursor 2 left to column 0 of the middle row, Space places it. The steamer scores kills in its row; the other rows are unguarded (no bark/zoomies used), so the final wave's crows and the last push reach the door after the scooters are spent -> mode game_over (debug seed 20261014: lost at t 58.6 s, score 255, 19 kills). 5400 frames total; the run ends early and the extra frames idle on the Results screen.
